item.description: A coastal storm may bring winter weather to the region around Thanksgiving. Forecasts vary, with some models predicting heavy snow and ice. The storm could disrupt travel and cause power outages, especially on Black Friday morning.
Vermont's unemployment rate stayed at two point six percent in October. The state ranks fourth lowest nationally. Labor force participation held steady at sixty-two point one percent.

Police found a dead woman in a ditch near the CVS in South Burlington on Saturday. The woman was likely in her thirties and showed no signs of struggle or injuries. Authorities suspect no foul play and are asking anyone with information to come forward.

Special Olympics Vermont hosted its annual regional bowling competition at Rutland Bowlerama this weekend. More than one hundred bowlers took part in the event. Athletes of all ages from across the state competed.
